_format: version = newest released launcher version, url = its download page/installer, notes = optional short changelog.
notes: Every chapter and season now starts local matchmaking from the normal Play button too, not only from the online-server menu. The local game host keeps its renderer open so Magnesium AutoHosting can start every playlist, waits for the correct build's login instead of another Fortnite log, and the chosen launcher username is used in-game.
